1.mohsin_khan: Kaf- Ha-Ya-'Ain-Sad. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Quran, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings].

2.sahih_international: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
2.pickthall: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.
2.yusuf_ali: (This is) a recital of the Mercy of thy Lord to His servant Zakariya.
2.shakir: A mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zakariya.
2.muhammad_sarwar: This is the story of the blessing of your Lord to His servant Zachariah.
2.mohsin_khan: (This is) a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zakariya (Zachariah).
2.arberry: The mention of thy Lord's mercy unto His servant Zachariah;

3.sahih_international: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
3.pickthall: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,
3.yusuf_ali: Behold! he cried to his Lord in secret,
3.shakir: When he called upon his Lord in a low voice,
3.muhammad_sarwar: When he quietly called his Lord
3.mohsin_khan: When he called out his Lord (Allah) a call in secret,
3.arberry: when he called upon his Lord secretly

4.sahih_international: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
4.pickthall: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.
4.yusuf_ali: Praying: "O my Lord! infirm indeed are my bones, and the hair of my head doth glisten with grey: but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to Thee!
4.shakir: He said: My Lord! surely my bones are weakened and my head flares with hoariness, and, my Lord! I have never been unsuccessful in my prayer to Thee:
4.muhammad_sarwar: and said, "My Lord, my bones have become feeble and my hair has turned white with age. Yet I have never been deprived in receiving from You the answer to my prayers.
4.mohsin_khan: Saying: "My Lord! Indeed my bones have grown feeble, and grey hair has spread on my head, And I have never been unblest in my invocation to You, O my Lord!
4.arberry: saying, 'O my Lord, behold the bones within me are feeble and my head is all aflame with hoariness. And in calling on Thee, my Lord, I have never been hitherto unprosperous.

5.sahih_international: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
5.pickthall: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor
5.yusuf_ali: "Now I fear (what) my relatives (and colleagues) (will do) after me: but my wife is barren: so give me an heir as from Thyself,-
5.shakir: And surely I fear my cousins after me, and my wife is barren, therefore grant me from Thyself an heir,
5.muhammad_sarwar: I am afraid of what my kinsmen will do after (my death) and my wife is barren. Lord, grant me a son
5.mohsin_khan: "And Verily! I fear my relatives after me, since my wife is barren. So give me from Yourself an heir,
5.arberry: And now I fear my kinsfolk after I am gone; and my wife is barren. So give me, from Thee, a kinsman

6.sahih_international: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
6.pickthall: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).
6.yusuf_ali: "(One that) will (truly) represent me, and represent the posterity of Jacob; and make him, O my Lord! one with whom Thou art well-pleased!"
6.shakir: Who should inherit me and inherit from the children of Yaqoub, and make him, my Lord, one in whom Thou art well pleased.
6.muhammad_sarwar: who will be my heir and the heir of the family of Jacob. Lord, make him a person who will please you".
6.mohsin_khan: "Who shall inherit me, and inherit (also) the posterity of Ya'qub (Jacob) (inheritance of the religious knowledge and Prophethood, not the wealth, etc.). And make him, my Lord, one with whom You are Well-pleased!".
6.arberry: who shall be my inheritor and the inheritor of the House of Jacob; and make him, my Lord, well-pleasing.'

7.sahih_international: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
7.pickthall: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).
7.yusuf_ali: (His prayer was answered): "O Zakariya! We give thee good news of a son: His name shall be Yahya: on none by that name have We conferred distinction before."
7.shakir: O Zakariya! surely We give you good news of a boy whose name shall be Yahya: We have not made before anyone his equal.
7.muhammad_sarwar: We answered his prayers with the glad news of the birth of a son by the name of John and told him, "We have never given such a name to anyone else."
7.mohsin_khan: (Allah said) "O Zakariya (Zachariah)! Verily, We give you the glad tidings of a son, His name will be Yahya (John). We have given that name to none before (him)."
7.arberry: 'O Zachariah, We give thee good tidings of a boy, whose name is John. No namesake have We given him aforetime.'

8.sahih_international: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
8.pickthall: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?
8.yusuf_ali: He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren and I have grown quite decrepit from old age?"
8.shakir: He said: O my Lord! when shall I have a son, and my wife is barren, and I myself have reached indeed the extreme degree of old age?
8.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "Lord, how can I have a son? My wife is barren and I have reached an extremely old age".
8.mohsin_khan: He said: "My Lord! How can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have reached the extreme old age."
8.arberry: He said, 'O my Lord, how shall I have a son, seeing my wife is barren, and I have attained to the declining of old age?'

9.sahih_international: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "
9.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.
9.yusuf_ali: He said: "So (it will be) thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: I did indeed create thee before, when thou hadst been nothing!'"
9.shakir: He said: So shall it be, your Lord says: It is easy to Me, and indeed I created you before, when you were nothing.
9.muhammad_sarwar: (The angel) said, "This is true, but your Lord says, 'For Me it is easy; I created you when you did not exist".
9.mohsin_khan: He said: "So (it will be). Your Lord says; It is easy for Me. Certainly I have created you before, when you had been nothing!"
9.arberry: Said He, 'So it shall be; thy Lord says, "Easy is that for Me, seeing that I created thee aforetime, when thou wast nothing."'

10.sahih_international: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
10.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.
10.yusuf_ali: (Zakariya) said: "O my Lord! give me a Sign." "Thy Sign," was the answer, "Shall be that thou shalt speak to no man for three nights, although thou art not dumb."
10.shakir: He said: My Lord! give me a sign. He said: Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to the people three nights while in sound health.
10.muhammad_sarwar: Zachariah asked, " Lord, show me evidence (if this is a heavenly news)." The Lord said, "The evidence for it is that you must not speak (to any mortal) though you are in good health for three nights (and days)."
10.mohsin_khan: [Zakariya (Zachariah)] said: "My Lord! Appoint for me a sign." He said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak unto mankind for three nights, though having no bodily defect."
10.arberry: He said, 'Lord, appoint to me some sign.' Said He, 'Thy sign is that thou shall not speak to men, though being without fault, three nights.'

11.sahih_international: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
11.pickthall: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.
11.yusuf_ali: So Zakariya came out to his people from him chamber: He told them by signs to celebrate Allah's praises in the morning and in the evening.
11.shakir: So he went forth to his people from his place of worship, then he made known to them that they should glorify (Allah) morning and evening.
11.muhammad_sarwar: Zachariah came out to his people from place of worship and inspired them to glorify the Lord both in the morning and evening.
11.mohsin_khan: Then he came out to his people from Al-Mihrab (a praying place or a private room, etc.), he told them by signs to glorify Allah's Praises in the morning and in the afternoon.
11.arberry: So he came forth unto his people from the Sanctuary, then he made signal to them, 'Give you glory at dawn and evening.'

12.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
12.pickthall: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,
12.yusuf_ali: (To his son came the command): "O Yahya! take hold of the Book with might": and We gave him Wisdom even as a youth,
12.shakir: O Yahya! take hold of the Book with strength, and We granted him wisdom while yet a child
12.muhammad_sarwar: We commanded John, Zachariah's son, to follow the guidance of the Lord with due steadfastness. To John We gave knowledge and wisdom to John during his childhood.
12.mohsin_khan: (It was said to his son): "O Yahya (John)! Hold fast the Scripture [the Taurat (Torah)]." And We gave him wisdom while yet a child.
12.arberry: 'O John, take the Book forcefully'; and We gave him judgment, yet a little child,

13.sahih_international: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
13.pickthall: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,
13.yusuf_ali: And piety (for all creatures) as from Us, and purity: He was devout,
13.shakir: And tenderness from Us and purity, and he was one who guarded (against evil),
13.muhammad_sarwar: We gave him compassion and purity. He was a pious human being,
13.mohsin_khan: And (made him) sympathetic to men as a mercy (or a grant) from Us, and pure from sins [i.e. Yahya (John)] and he was righteous,
13.arberry: and a tenderness from Us, and purity; and he was godfearing,

14.sahih_international: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
14.pickthall: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.
14.yusuf_ali: And kind to his parents, and he was not overbearing or rebellious.
14.shakir: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not insolent, disobedient.
14.muhammad_sarwar: kind to his parents, not arrogant or a rebellious person.
14.mohsin_khan: And dutiful towards his parents, and he was neither an arrogant nor disobedient (to Allah or to his parents).
14.arberry: and cherishing his parents, not arrogant, rebellious.

15.sahih_international: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
15.pickthall: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!
15.yusuf_ali: So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!
15.shakir: And peace on him on the day he was born, and on the day he dies, and on the day he is raised to life
15.muhammad_sarwar: He was born and died in peace and will be brought back to life again in peace.
15.mohsin_khan: So Peace on him the day he was born the day that he dies and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!
15.arberry: 'Peace be upon him, the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he is raised up alive!'

16.sahih_international: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
16.pickthall: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,
16.yusuf_ali: Relate in the Book (the story of) Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place in the East.
16.shakir: And mention Marium in the Book when she drew aside from her family to an eastern place;
16.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), mention in the Book (the Quran) the story of Mary how she left her family and started living in a solitary place to the East
16.mohsin_khan: And mention in the Book (the Quran, O Muhammad SAW, the story of) Maryam (Mary), when she withdrew in seclusion from her family to a place facing east.
16.arberry: And mention in the Book Mary when she withdrew from her people to an eastern place,

17.sahih_international: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
17.pickthall: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.
17.yusuf_ali: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent her our angel, and he appeared before her as a man in all respects.
17.shakir: So she took a veil (to screen herself) from them; then We sent to her Our spirit, and there appeared to her a well-made man.
17.muhammad_sarwar: out of her people's sight. We sent Our Spirit to her, who stood before her in the shape of a well formed human being.
17.mohsin_khan: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent to her Our Ruh [angel Jibrael (Gabriel)], and he appeared before her in the form of a man in all respects.
17.arberry: and she took a veil apart from them; then We sent unto her Our Spirit that presented himself to her a man without fault.

18.sahih_international: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."
18.pickthall: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.
18.yusuf_ali: She said: "I seek refuge from thee to (Allah) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah."
18.shakir: She said: Surely I fly for refuge from you to the Beneficent Allah, if you are one guarding (against evil).
18.muhammad_sarwar: Mary said, "Would that the Beneficent God would protect me from you. Leave me alone if you are a God fearing person".
18.mohsin_khan: She said: "Verily! I seek refuge with the Most Beneficent (Allah) from you, if you do fear Allah."
18.arberry: She said, 'I take refuge in the All-merciful from thee!

19.sahih_international: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
19.pickthall: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.
19.yusuf_ali: He said: "Nay, I am only a messenger from thy Lord, (to announce) to thee the gift of a holy son.
19.shakir: He said: I am only a messenger of your Lord: That I will give you a pure boy.
19.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "I am the Messengers of your Lord. I have come to give you a purified son".
19.mohsin_khan: (The angel) said: "I am only a Messenger from your Lord, (to announce) to you the gift of a righteous son."
19.arberry: If thou fearest God... He said, 'I am but a messenger come from thy Lord, to give thee a boy most pure.

20.sahih_international: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
20.pickthall: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?
20.yusuf_ali: She said: "How shall I have a son, seeing that no man has touched me, and I am not unchaste?"
20.shakir: She said: When shall I have a boy and no mortal has yet touched me, nor have I been unchaste?
20.muhammad_sarwar: She said, "How can I have a son when no mortal has touched me nor am I an unchaste woman".
20.mohsin_khan: She said: "How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, nor am I unchaste?"
20.arberry: She said, 'How shall I have a son whom no mortal has touched, neither have I been unchaste?'

21.sahih_international: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
21.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.
21.yusuf_ali: He said: "So (it will be): Thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: and (We wish) to appoint him as a Sign unto men and a Mercy from Us': It is a matter (so) decreed."
21.shakir: He said: Even so; your Lord says: It is easy to Me: and that We may make him a sign to men and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter which has been decreed.
21.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "This is true but your Lord says, "It is very easy for Me. We have decided to give you a son as evidence (of Our existence) for human beings and a mercy from Us. This is a decree already ordained."
21.mohsin_khan: He said: "So (it will be), your Lord said: 'That is easy for Me (Allah): And (We wish) to appoint him as a sign to mankind and a mercy from Us (Allah), and it is a matter (already) decreed, (by Allah). 
21.arberry: He said, 'Even so thy Lord has said: "Easy is that for Me; and that We may appoint him a sign unto men and a mercy from Us; it is a thing decreed."'

22.sahih_international: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
22.pickthall: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.
22.yusuf_ali: So she conceived him, and she retired with him to a remote place.
22.shakir: So she conceived him; then withdrew herself with him to a remote place.
22.muhammad_sarwar: She conceived the child and retreated with him to a distant and solitary place.
22.mohsin_khan: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place (i.e. Bethlehem valley about 4-6 miles from Jerusalem).
22.arberry: So she conceived him, and withdrew with him to a distant place.

23.sahih_international: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
23.pickthall: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!
23.yusuf_ali: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree: She cried (in her anguish): "Ah! would that I had died before this! would that I had been a thing forgotten and out of sight!"
23.shakir: And the throes (of childbirth) compelled her to betake herself to the trunk of a palm tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died before this, and had been a thing quite forgotten!
23.muhammad_sarwar: When she started to experience (the pain of) of childbirth labor, by the trunk of a palm tree in sadness she said, "Would that I had died long before and passed into oblivion."
23.mohsin_khan: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a date-palm. She said: "Would that I had died before this, and had been forgotten and out of sight!"
23.arberry: And the birthpangs surprised her by the trunk of the palm-tree. She said, 'Would I had died ere this, and become a thing forgotten!'

24.sahih_international: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
24.pickthall: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,
24.yusuf_ali: But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee;
24.shakir: Then (the child) called out to her from beneath her: Grieve not, surely your Lord has made a stream to flow beneath you;
24.muhammad_sarwar: Then she heard the baby saying, "Do not be sad. Your Lord has caused a stream to run at your feet.
24.mohsin_khan: Then [the babe 'Iesa (Jesus) or Jibrael (Gabriel)] cried unto her from below her, saying: "Grieve not! Your Lord has provided a water stream under you;
24.arberry: But the one that was below her called to her, 'Nay, do not sorrow; see, thy Lord has set below thee a rivulet.

25.sahih_international: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
25.pickthall: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.
25.yusuf_ali: "And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree: It will let fall fresh ripe dates upon thee.
25.shakir: And shake towards you the trunk of the palmtree, it will drop on you fresh ripe dates:
25.muhammad_sarwar: If you shake the trunk of the palm tree, it will provide you with fresh ripe dates.
25.mohsin_khan: "And shake the trunk of date-palm towards you, it will let fall fresh ripe-dates upon you."
25.arberry: Shake also to thee the palm-trunk, and there shall come tumbling upon thee dates fresh and ripe.

26.sahih_international: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
26.pickthall: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.
26.yusuf_ali: "So eat and drink and cool (thine) eye. And if thou dost see any man, say, 'I have vowed a fast to (Allah) Most Gracious, and this day will I enter into not talk with any human being'"
26.shakir: So eat and drink and refresh the eye. Then if you see any mortal, say: Surely I have vowed a fast to the Beneficent Allah, so I shall not speak to any man today.
26.muhammad_sarwar: Eat, drink, and rejoice. Should you see a person going by, tell him that on this day you have promised the Beneficent God to fast and never talk to any human being."
26.mohsin_khan: "So eat and drink and be glad, and if you see any human being, say: 'Verily! I have vowed a fast unto the Most Beneficent (Allah) so I shall not speak to any human being this day. 
26.arberry: Eat therefore, and drink, and be comforted; and if thou shouldst see any mortal, say, "I have vowed to the All-merciful a fast, and today I will not speak to any man.

27.sahih_international: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
27.pickthall: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.
27.yusuf_ali: At length she brought the (babe) to her people, carrying him (in her arms). They said: "O Mary! truly an amazing thing hast thou brought!
27.shakir: And she came to her people with him, carrying him (with her). They said: O Marium! surely you have done a strange thing.
27.muhammad_sarwar: She took him to her people and they said, "Mary, this is indeed an strange thing.
27.mohsin_khan: Then she brought him (the baby) to her people, carrying him. They said: "O Mary! Indeed you have brought a thing Fariya (an unheard mighty thing).
27.arberry: Then she brought the child to her folk carrying him; and they said, 'Mary, thou hast surely committed a monstrous thing!

28.sahih_international: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
28.pickthall: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.
28.yusuf_ali: "O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of evil, nor thy mother a woman unchaste!"
28.shakir: O sister of Haroun! your father was not a bad man, nor, was your mother an unchaste woman.
28.muhammad_sarwar: Aaron's sister, your father was not a bad man nor was your mother unchaste".
28.mohsin_khan: "O sister (i.e. the like) of Harun (Aaron) [not the brother of Musa (Moses), but he was another pious man at the time of Maryam (Mary)]! Your father was not a man who used to commit adultery, nor your mother was an unchaste woman."
28.arberry: Sister of Aaron, thy father was not a wicked man, nor was thy mother a woman unchaste.'

29.sahih_international: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
29.pickthall: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?
29.yusuf_ali: But she pointed to the babe. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"
29.shakir: But she pointed to him. They said: How should we speak to one who was a child in the cradle?
29.muhammad_sarwar: She pointed to the baby (and referred them to him for their answer). They said, "How can we talk to a baby in the cradle?"
29.mohsin_khan: Then she pointed to him. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"
29.arberry: Mary pointed to the child then; but they said, 'How shall we speak to one who is still in the cradle, a little child?'

30.sahih_international: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
30.pickthall: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,
30.yusuf_ali: He said: "I am indeed a servant of Allah: He hath given me revelation and made me a prophet;
30.shakir: He said: Surely I am a servant of Allah; He has given me the Book and made me a prophet;
30.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "I am the servant of God. He has given me the Book and has appointed me to be a Prophet.
30.mohsin_khan: "He ['Iesa (Jesus)] said: Verily! I am a slave of Allah, He has given me the Scripture and made me a Prophet;"
30.arberry: He said, 'Lo, I am God's servant; God has given me the Book, and made me a Prophet.

31.sahih_international: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
31.pickthall: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,
31.yusuf_ali: "And He hath made me blessed wheresoever I be, and hath enjoined on me Prayer and Charity as long as I live;
31.shakir: And He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and He has enjoined on me prayer and poor-rate so long as I live;
31.muhammad_sarwar: He has blessed me no matter where I dwell, commanded me to worship Him and pay the religious tax for as long as I live.
31.mohsin_khan: "And He has made me blessed wheresoever I be, and has enjoined on me Salat (prayer), and Zakat, as long as I live."
31.arberry: Blessed He has made me, wherever I may be; and He has enjoined me to pray, and to give the alms, so long as I live,

32.sahih_international: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
32.pickthall: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
32.yusuf_ali: "(He) hath made me kind to my mother, and not overbearing or miserable;
32.shakir: And dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me insolent, unblessed;
32.muhammad_sarwar: He has commanded me to be good to my parents and has not made me an arrogant rebellious person.
32.mohsin_khan: "And dutiful to my mother, and made me not arrogant, unblest.
32.arberry: and likewise to cherish my mother; He has not made me arrogant, unprosperous.

33.sahih_international: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
33.pickthall: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
33.yusuf_ali: "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!
33.shakir: And peace on me on the day I was born, and on the day I die, and on the day I am raised to life.
33.muhammad_sarwar: I was born with peace and I shall die and be brought to life again with peace."
33.mohsin_khan: "And Salam (peace) be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!"
33.arberry: Peace be upon me, the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised up alive!'

34.sahih_international: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
34.pickthall: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.
34.yusuf_ali: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute.
34.shakir: Such is Isa, son of Marium; (this is) the saying of truth about which they dispute.
34.muhammad_sarwar: Such was the true story of Jesus, the son of Mary, about which they dispute bitterly.
34.mohsin_khan: Such is 'Iesa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary). (it is) a statement of truth, about which they doubt (or dispute).
34.arberry: That is Jesus, son of Mary, in word of truth, concerning which they are doubting.

35.sahih_international: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
35.pickthall: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
35.yusuf_ali: It is not befitting to (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glory be to Him! when He determines a matter, He only says to it, "Be", and it is.
35.shakir: It beseems not Allah that He should take to Himself a son, glory to be Him; when He has decreed a matter He only says to it "Be," and it is.
35.muhammad_sarwar: God is too Exalted to have a son. When He decides to bring some thing into existence He needs only command it to exist and it comes into existence.
35.mohsin_khan: It befits not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son [this refers to the slander of Christians against Allah, by saying that 'Iesa (Jesus) is the son of Allah]. Glorified (and Exalted be He above all that they associate with Him). When He decrees a thing, He only says to it, "Be!" and it is.
35.arberry: It is not for God to take a son unto Him. Glory be to Him! When He decrees a thing, He but says to it 'Be,' and it is.

36.sahih_international: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
36.pickthall: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.
36.yusuf_ali: Verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord: Him therefore serve ye: this is a Way that is straight.
36.shakir: And surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord, therefore serve Him; this is the right path.
36.muhammad_sarwar: (Baby Jesus said), "Worship God who is my Lord as well as yours. This is the straight path".
36.mohsin_khan: ['Iesa (Jesus) said]: "And verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him (Alone). That is the Straight Path. (Allah's Religion of Islamic Monotheism which He did ordain for all of His Prophets)." [Tafsir At-Tabari]
36.arberry: Surely God is my Lord, and your Lord; So serve you Him. This is a straight path.

37.sahih_international: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
37.pickthall: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.
37.yusuf_ali: But the sects differ among themselves: and woe to the unbelievers because of the (coming) Judgment of a Momentous Day!
37.shakir: But parties from among them disagreed with each other, so woe to those who disbelieve, because of presence on a great day.
37.muhammad_sarwar: (The followers of Jesus) turned themselves into quarrelling sects. The disbelievers shall face a woeful condition on the great Day (of Judgment).
37.mohsin_khan: Then the sects differed [i.e. the Christians about 'Iesa (Jesus)], so woe unto the disbelievers [those who gave false witness by saying that 'Iesa (Jesus) is the son of Allah] from the meeting of a great Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection, when they will be thrown in the blazing Fire).
37.arberry: But the parties have fallen into variance among themselves; then woe to those who disbelieve for the scene of a dreadful day.

38.sahih_international: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
38.pickthall: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
38.yusuf_ali: How plainly will they see and hear, the Day that they will appear before Us! but the unjust today are in error manifest!
38.shakir: How clearly shall they hear and how clearly shall they see on the day when they come to Us; but the unjust this day are in manifest error.
38.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), how clearly they will hear and see on the day when they will be brought into Our presence. Today the wrong doers are in manifest error.
38.mohsin_khan: How clearly will they (polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah) see and hear, the Day when they will appear before Us! But the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers) today are in plain error.
38.arberry: How well they will hear and see on the day they come to Us! But the evildoers even today are in error manifest.

39.sahih_international: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
39.pickthall: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.
39.yusuf_ali: But warn them of the Day of Distress, when the matter will be determined: for (behold,) they are negligent and they do not believe!
39.shakir: And warn them of the day of intense regret, when the matter shall have been decided; and they are (now) in negligence and they do not believe.
39.muhammad_sarwar: Warn them of the woeful day when the final decree will be issued; they are neglectful and faithless.
39.mohsin_khan: And warn them (O Muhammad SAW) of the Day of grief and regrets, when the case has been decided, while (now) they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.
39.arberry: Warn thou them of the day of anguish, when the matter shall be determined, and they yet heedless and unbelieving.

40.sahih_international: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
40.pickthall: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.
40.yusuf_ali: It is We Who will inherit the earth, and all beings thereon: to Us will they all be returned.
40.shakir: Surely We inherit the earth and all those who are on it, and to Us they shall be returned.
40.muhammad_sarwar: We are the heirs of the earth and those living in it will all return to Us.
40.mohsin_khan: Verily! We will inherit the earth and whatsoever is thereon. And to Us they all shall be returned,
40.arberry: Surely We shall inherit the earth and all that are upon it, and unto Us they shall be returned.

41.sahih_international: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
41.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.
41.yusuf_ali: (Also mention in the Book (the story of) Abraham: He was a man of Truth, a prophet.
41.shakir: And mention Ibrahim in the Book; surely he was a truthful man, a prophet.
41.muhammad_sarwar: Mention the story of Abraham, the truthful Prophet, in the Book (the Quran)
41.mohsin_khan: And mention in the Book (the Quran) Ibrahim (Abraham). Verily! He was a man of truth, a Prophet.
41.arberry: And mention in the Book Abraham; surely he was a true man, a Prophet.

42.sahih_international: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
42.pickthall: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?
42.yusuf_ali: Behold, he said to his father: "O my father! why worship that which heareth not and seeth not, and can profit thee nothing?
42.shakir: When he said to his father; O my father! why do you worship what neither hears nor sees, nor does it avail you in the least:
42.muhammad_sarwar: who asked his father, "Father, why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see nor help you at all?
42.mohsin_khan: When he said to his father: "O my father! Why do you worship that which hears not, sees not and cannot avail you in anything?
42.arberry: When he said to his father, 'Father, why worshippest thou that which neither hears nor sees, nor avails thee anything?

43.sahih_international: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
43.pickthall: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.
43.yusuf_ali: "O my father! to me hath come knowledge which hath not reached thee: so follow me: I will guide thee to a way that is even and straight.
43.shakir: O my father! truly the knowledge has come to me which has not come to you, therefore follow me, I will guide you on a right path:
43.muhammad_sarwar: Father, I have received the knowledge which has not been given to you. Follow me; I shall guide you to the right path.
43.mohsin_khan: "O my father! Verily! There has come to me of knowledge that which came not unto you. So follow me. I will guide you to a Straight Path.
43.arberry: Father, there has come to me knowledge such as came not to thee; so follow me, and I will guide thee on a level path.

44.sahih_international: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
44.pickthall: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.
44.yusuf_ali: "O my father! serve not Satan: for Satan is a rebel against (Allah) Most Gracious.
44.shakir: O my father! serve not the Shaitan, surely the Shaitan is disobedient to the Beneficent Allah:
44.muhammad_sarwar: Father, do not worship satan; he has disobeyed the Beneficent God.
44.mohsin_khan: "O my father! Worship not Shaitan (Satan). Verily! Shaitan (Satan) has been a rebel against the Most Beneficent (Allah).
44.arberry: Father, serve not Satan; surely Satan is a rebel against the All-merciful.

45.sahih_international: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
45.pickthall: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.
45.yusuf_ali: "O my father! I fear lest a Penalty afflict thee from (Allah) Most Gracious, so that thou become to Satan a friend."
45.shakir: O my father! surely I fear that a punishment from the Beneficent Allah should afflict you so that you should be a friend of the Shaitan.
45.muhammad_sarwar: Father, I am afraid that the Beneficent God's torment will strike you and you will become a friend of satan."
45.mohsin_khan: "O my father! Verily! I fear lest a torment from the Most Beneficent (Allah) overtake you, so that you become a companion of Shaitan (Satan) (in the Hell-fire)." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]
45.arberry: Father, I fear that some chastisement from the All-merciful will smite thee, so that thou becomest a friend to Satan.

46.sahih_international: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
46.pickthall: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!
46.yusuf_ali: (The father) replied: "Dost thou hate my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will indeed stone thee: Now get away from me for a good long while!"
46.shakir: He said: Do you dislike my gods, O Ibrahim? If you do not desist I will certainly revile you, and leave me for a time.
46.muhammad_sarwar: His father replied, "Abraham, are you telling me to give-up my gods? If you will not stop this, I shall stone you to death. Leave my house and do not come back again".
46.mohsin_khan: He (the father) said: "Do you reject my gods, O Ibrahim (Abraham)? If you stop not (this), I will indeed stone you. So get away from me safely before I punish you."
46.arberry: Said he, 'What, art thou shrinking from my gods, Abraham? Surely, if thou givest not over, I shall stone thee; so forsake me now for some while.'

47.sahih_international: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
47.pickthall: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.
47.yusuf_ali: Abraham said: "Peace be on thee: I will pray to my Lord for thy forgiveness: for He is to me Most Gracious.
47.shakir: He said: Peace be on you, I will pray to my Lord to forgive you; surely He is ever Affectionate to me:
47.muhammad_sarwar: Abraham said, "Peace be with you. I shall ask my Lord to forgive you; He has been gracious to me.
47.mohsin_khan: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: "Peace be on you! I will ask Forgiveness of my Lord for you. Verily! He is unto me, Ever Most Gracious.
47.arberry: He said, 'Peace be upon thee! I will ask my Lord to forgive thee; surely He is ever gracious to me.

48.sahih_international: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
48.pickthall: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
48.yusuf_ali: "And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest."
48.shakir: And I will withdraw from you and what you call on besides Allah, and I will call upon my Lord; may be I shall not remain unblessed in calling upon my Lord.
48.muhammad_sarwar: I shall stay away from you and what you worship instead of God. I worship my Lord and hope that my prayers will not be ignored."
48.mohsin_khan: "And I shall turn away from you and from those whom you invoke besides Allah. And I shall call on my Lord; and I hope that I shall not be unblest in my invocation to my Lord."
48.arberry: Now I will go apart from you and that you call upon, apart from God; I will call upon my Lord, and haply I shall not be, in calling upon my Lord, unprosperous.

49.sahih_international: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
49.pickthall: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.
49.yusuf_ali: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet.
49.shakir: So when he withdrew from them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We gave to him Ishaq and Yaqoub, and each one of them We made a prophet.
49.muhammad_sarwar: When (Abraham) rejected his people and what they worshipped instead of God, We gave him Isaac and Jacob and made both of them Prophets.
49.mohsin_khan: So when he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Ishaque (Isaac) and Ya'qub (Jacob), and each one of them We made a Prophet.
49.arberry: So, when he went apart from them and that they were serving, apart from God, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each We made a Prophet;

50.sahih_international: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
50.pickthall: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.
50.yusuf_ali: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth.
50.shakir: And We granted to them of Our mercy, and We left (behind them) a truthful mention of eminence for them.
50.muhammad_sarwar: We granted them Our blessing and high renown.
50.mohsin_khan: And We gave them of Our Mercy (a good provision in plenty), and We granted them honour on the tongues (of all the nations, i.e. everybody remembers them with a good praise).
50.arberry: and We gave them of Our mercy, and We appointed unto them a tongue of truthfulness, sublime.

51.sahih_international: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
51.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
51.yusuf_ali: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
51.shakir: And mention Musa in the Book; surely he was one purified, and he was an apostle, a prophet.
51.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), mention in the Book (the Quran) the story of Moses. Moses was a sincere person, a Messengers and a Prophet.
51.mohsin_khan: And mention in the Book (this Quran) Musa (Moses). Verily! He was chosen and he was a Messenger (and) a Prophet.
51.arberry: And mention in the Book Moses; he was devoted, and he was a Messenger, a Prophet.

52.sahih_international: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
52.pickthall: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.
52.yusuf_ali: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse).
52.shakir: And We called to him from the blessed side of the mountain, and We made him draw nigh, holding communion (with Us).
52.muhammad_sarwar: We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai and drew him close for communication.
52.mohsin_khan: And We called him from the right side of the Mount, and made him draw near to Us for a talk with him [Musa (Moses)].
52.arberry: We called to him from the right side Of the Mount, and We brought him near in communion.

53.sahih_international: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
53.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).
53.yusuf_ali: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet.
53.shakir: And We gave to him out of Our mercy his brother Haroun a prophet.
53.muhammad_sarwar: Out of Our mercy We gave him his brother Aaron who himself was a Prophet.
53.mohsin_khan: And We bestowed on him his brother Harun (Aaron), (also) a Prophet, out of Our Mercy.
53.arberry: And We gave him his brother Aaron, of Our mercy, a Prophet.

54.sahih_international: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
54.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
54.yusuf_ali: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
54.shakir: And mention Ismail in the Book; surely he was truthful in (his) promise, and he was an apostle, a prophet.
54.muhammad_sarwar: Mention in the Book (the Quran) the story of Ishmael; he was true to his promise, a Messengers and a Prophet.
54.mohsin_khan: And mention in the Book (the Quran) Isma'il (Ishmael). Verily! He was true to what he promised, and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet.
54.arberry: And mention in the Book Ishmael; he was true to his promise, and he was a Messenger, a Prophet.

55.sahih_international: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
55.pickthall: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
55.yusuf_ali: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
55.shakir: And he enjoined on his family prayer and almsgiving, and was one in whom his Lord was well pleased.
55.muhammad_sarwar: He would order his people to worship God and pay the religious tax. His Lord was pleased with him.
55.mohsin_khan: And he used to enjoin on his family and his people As-Salat (the prayers) and the Zakat, and his Lord was pleased with him.
55.arberry: He bade his people to pray and to give the alms, and he was pleasing to his Lord.

56.sahih_international: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
56.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;
56.yusuf_ali: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet:
56.shakir: And mention Idris in the Book; surely he was a truthful man, a prophet,
56.muhammad_sarwar: Mention in the Book (the Quran) the story of Idris (Enoch); he was a truthful Prophet.
56.mohsin_khan: And mention in the Book (the Quran) Idris (Enoch). Verily! He was a man of truth, (and) a Prophet.
56.arberry: And mention in the Book Idris; he was a true man, a Prophet.

57.sahih_international: And We raised him to a high station.
57.pickthall: And We raised him to high station.
57.yusuf_ali: And We raised him to a lofty station.
57.shakir: And We raised him high in Heaven.
57.muhammad_sarwar: We granted him a high position.
57.mohsin_khan: And We raised him to a high station.
57.arberry: We raised him up to a high place.

58.sahih_international: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
58.pickthall: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.
58.yusuf_ali: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears.
58.shakir: These are they on whom Allah bestowed favors, from among the prophets of the seed of Adam, and of those whom We carried with Nuh, and of the seed of Ibrahim and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose; when the communications of the Beneficent Allah were recited to them, they fell down making obeisance and weeping.
58.muhammad_sarwar: These were the Prophets from the offspring of Adam, from those who embarked with Noah and from the offspring of Abraham and Israel. God guided them and chose them for His favor. Whenever they would hear the revelations of the Beneficent God they would bow down in prostration with tears.
58.mohsin_khan: Those were they unto whom Allah bestowed His Grace from among the Prophets, of the offspring of Adam, and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Nuh (Noah), and of the offspring of Ibrahim (Abraham) and Israel and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the Verses of the Most Beneficent (Allah) were recited unto them, they fell down prostrating and weeping.
58.arberry: These are they whom God has blessed among the Prophets of the seed of Adam, and of those We bore with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and of those We guided and chose. When the signs of the All-merciful were recited to them, they fell down prostrate, weeping.

59.sahih_international: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
59.pickthall: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.
59.yusuf_ali: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction,-
59.shakir: But there came after them an evil generation, who neglected prayers and followed and sensual desires, so they win meet perdition,
59.muhammad_sarwar: They were succeeded by a generation who neglected their prayers and followed their worldly desires. They will certainly be lost,
59.mohsin_khan: Then, there has succeeded them a posterity who have given up As-Salat (the prayers) [i.e. made their Salat (prayers) to be lost, either by not offering them or by not offering them perfectly or by not offering them in their proper fixed times, etc.] and have followed lusts. So they will be thrown in Hell.
59.arberry: Then there succeeded after them a succession who wasted the prayer, and followed lusts; so they shall encounter error

60.sahih_international: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
60.pickthall: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -
60.yusuf_ali: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least,-
60.shakir: Except such as repent and believe and do good, these shall enter the garden, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly in any way:
60.muhammad_sarwar: but those among them who repent and become righteously striving believers will be admitted to the gardens without experiencing any injustice.
60.mohsin_khan: Except those who repent and believe (in the Oneness of Allah and His Messenger Muhammad SAW), and work righteousness. Such will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in aught.
60.arberry: save him who repents, and believes, and does a righteous deed; those -- they shall enter Paradise, and they shall not be wronged anything;

61.sahih_international: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
61.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -
61.yusuf_ali: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass.
61.shakir: The gardens of perpetuity which the Beneficent Allah has promised to His servants while unseen; surely His promise shall come to pass.
61.muhammad_sarwar: They will be admitted to the garden of Eden which is the unseen promise of the Beneficent God to His servants. The promise of God will certainly come true.
61.mohsin_khan: (They will enter) 'Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), which the Most Beneficent (Allah) has promised to His slaves in the unseen: Verily! His Promise must come to pass.
61.arberry: Gardens of Eden that the All-merciful promised His servants in the Unseen; His promise is ever performed.

62.sahih_international: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
62.pickthall: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
62.yusuf_ali: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening.
62.shakir: They shall not hear therein any vain discourse, but only: Peace, and they shall have their sustenance therein morning and evening.
62.muhammad_sarwar: They will not hear therein any meaningless words. They will be greeted (by the angels) with "Peace be with you," and they will receive their sustenance both in the mornings and evenings.
62.mohsin_khan: They shall not hear therein (in Paradise) any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk), but only Salam (salutations of peace). And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and afternoon. [See (V. 40:55)].
62.arberry: There they shall hear no idle talk, but only 'Peace.' There they shall have their provision at dawn and evening.

63.sahih_international: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
63.pickthall: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
63.yusuf_ali: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil.
63.shakir: This is the garden which We cause those of Our servants to inherit who guard (against evil).
63.muhammad_sarwar: Such are the gardens which We will give to Our God-fearing servants as their inherited property.
63.mohsin_khan: Such is the Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who have been Al-Muttaqun (pious and righteous persons - See V. 2:2).
63.arberry: That is Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who are godfearing.

64.sahih_international: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
64.pickthall: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
64.yusuf_ali: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget,-
64.shakir: And we do not descend but by the command of your Lord; to Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is between these, and your Lord is not forgetful.
64.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), we (the angels) do not come to you without being commanded by your Lord to do so. To Him belongs all that is before us, behind us, and in between. Your Lord is not forgetful.
64.mohsin_khan: And we (angels) descend not except by the Command of your Lord (O Muhammad SAW). To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two, and your Lord is never forgetful,
64.arberry: We come not down, save at the commandment of thy Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us, and all that is behind us, and all between that.

65.sahih_international: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
65.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?
65.yusuf_ali: "Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He?"
65.shakir: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, so serve Him and be patient in His service. Do you know any one equal to Him?
65.muhammad_sarwar: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. Worship Him and be steadfast in your worship of Him; none is equal to Him.
65.mohsin_khan: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, so worship Him (Alone) and be constant and patient in His worship. Do you know of any who is similar to Him? (of course none is similar or coequal or comparable to Him, and He has none as partner with Him). [There is nothing like unto Him and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer].
65.arberry: And thy Lord is never forgetful, Lord He of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So serve Him, and be thou patient in His service; knowest thou any that can be named with His Name?

66.sahih_international: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
66.pickthall: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
66.yusuf_ali: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
66.shakir: And says man: What! when I am dead shall I truly be brought forth alive?
66.muhammad_sarwar: The human being says, "Shall I be brought to life again after I will die?"
66.mohsin_khan: And man (the disbeliever) says: "When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
66.arberry: Man says, 'What, when I am dead shall I then be brought forth alive?'

67.sahih_international: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
67.pickthall: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
67.yusuf_ali: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing?
67.shakir: Does not man remember that We created him before, when he was nothing?
67.muhammad_sarwar: Does he not remember that We created him when he did not exist?
67.mohsin_khan: Does not man remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
67.arberry: Will not man remember that We created him aforetime, when he was nothing?

68.sahih_international: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
68.pickthall: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.
68.yusuf_ali: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell;
68.shakir: So by your Lord! We will most certainly gather them together and the Shaitans, then shall We certainly cause them to be present round hell on their knees.
68.muhammad_sarwar: By your Lord, We will bring them back to life with satan and gather them around hell in large groups.
68.mohsin_khan: So by your Lord, surely, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Shayatin (devils) (with them), then We shall bring them round Hell on their knees.
68.arberry: Now, by thy Lord, We shall surely muster them, and the Satans, then We shall parade them about Gehenna hobbling on their knees.

69.sahih_international: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
69.pickthall: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
69.yusuf_ali: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious.
69.shakir: Then We will most certainly draw forth from every sect of them him who is most exorbitantly rebellious against the Beneficent Allah.
69.muhammad_sarwar: Then We will separate from every group those who were strongly rebellious against the Beneficent God.
69.mohsin_khan: Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Beneficent (Allah).
69.arberry: Then We shall pluck forth from every party whichever of them was the most hardened in disdain of the All-merciful;

70.sahih_international: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
70.pickthall: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.
70.yusuf_ali: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein.
70.shakir: Again We do certainly know best those who deserve most to be burned therein.
70.muhammad_sarwar: We know best who deserves greater suffering in hell fire.
70.mohsin_khan: Then, verily, We know best those who are most worthy of being burnt therein.
70.arberry: then We shall know very well those most deserving to burn there.

71.sahih_international: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
71.pickthall: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.
71.yusuf_ali: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished.
71.shakir: And there is not one of you but shall come to it; this is an unavoidable decree of your Lord.
71.muhammad_sarwar: It is the inevitable decree of your Lord that every one of you will be taken to hell.
71.mohsin_khan: There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell); this is with your Lord; a Decree which must be accomplished.
71.arberry: Not one of you there is, but he shall go down to it; that for thy Lord is a thing decreed, determined.

72.sahih_international: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
72.pickthall: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
72.yusuf_ali: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees.
72.shakir: And We will deliver those who guarded (against evil), and We will leave the unjust therein on their knees.
72.muhammad_sarwar: We will save the pious ones from the hell fire and leave the unjust people therein in crowded groups.
72.mohsin_khan: Then We shall save those who use to fear Allah and were dutiful to Him. And We shall leave the Zalimun (polytheists and wrongdoers, etc.) therein (humbled) to their knees (in Hell).
72.arberry: Then We shall deliver those that were godfearing; and the evildoers We shall leave there, hobbling on their knees.

73.sahih_international: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
73.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?
73.yusuf_ali: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council?"
73.shakir: And when Our clear communications are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: Which of the two parties is best in abiding and best in assembly?
73.muhammad_sarwar: When Our revelations are recited to them, the unbelievers say to the faithful ones, "Which of us is more prosperous?"
73.mohsin_khan: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve (the rich and strong among the pagans of Quraish who live a life of luxury) say to those who believe (the weak, poor companions of Prophet Muhammad SAW who have a hard life): "Which of the two groups (i.e. believers and disbelievers) is best in (point of) position and as regards station (place of council for consultation)."
73.arberry: When Our signs are recited to them as clear signs, the unbelievers say to the believers, 'Which of the two parties is better in station, fairer in assembly?'

74.sahih_international: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
74.pickthall: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!
74.yusuf_ali: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye?
74.shakir: And how many of the generations have We destroyed before them who were better in respect of goods and outward appearance!
74.muhammad_sarwar: How many generations of greater prosperity and splendor have We destroyed before them?
74.mohsin_khan: And how many a generation (past nations) have We destroyed before them, who were better in wealth, goods and outward appearance?
74.arberry: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were fairer in furnishing and outward show!

75.sahih_international: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
75.pickthall: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.
75.yusuf_ali: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces!
75.shakir: Say: As for him who remains in error, the Beneficent Allah will surely prolong his length of days, until they see what they were threatened with, either the punishment or the hour; then they shall know who is in more evil plight and weaker in forces
75.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them, "The Beneficent God gives respite to those who have gone astray only until they face the torment with which they were threatened or to the Day of Judgment. Then they will find out who will have the most miserable place and the weakest forces.
75.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW) whoever is in error, the Most Beneficent (Allah) will extend (the rope) to him, until, when they see that which they were promised, either the torment or the Hour, they will come to know who is worst in position, and who is weaker in forces. [This is the answer for the Verse No. 19:73]
75.arberry: Say: 'Whosoever is in error, let the All-merciful prolong his term for him! Till, when they see that they were threatened, whether the chastisement, or the Hour, then they shall surely know who is worse in place, and who is weaker in hosts.'

76.sahih_international: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
76.pickthall: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
76.yusuf_ali: "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
76.shakir: And Allah increases in guidance those who go aright; and ever-abiding good works are with your Lord best in recompense and best in yielding fruit.
76.muhammad_sarwar: God further enlightens those who seek guidance. To those who do charitable deeds which produce continuing benefits, your Lord will give a better reward and a better place in Paradise.
76.mohsin_khan: And Allah increases in guidance those who walk aright [true believers in the Oneness of Allah who fear Allah much (abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden), and love Allah much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)]. And the righteous good deeds that last, are better with your Lord, for reward and better for resort.
76.arberry: And God shall increase those who were guided in guidance; and the abiding things, the deeds of righteousness, are better with thy Lord in reward, and better in return

77.sahih_international: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
77.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?
77.yusuf_ali: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
77.shakir: Have you, then, seen him who disbelieves in Our communications and says: I shall certainly be given wealth and children?
77.muhammad_sarwar: Note the words of the disbeliever, "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
77.mohsin_khan: Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayat (this Quran and Muhammad SAW) and (yet) says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children [if I will be alive (again)],"
77.arberry: Hast thou seen him who disbelieves in Our signs and says, 'Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children'?

78.sahih_international: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
78.pickthall: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?
78.yusuf_ali: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious?
78.shakir: Has he gained knowledge of the unseen, or made a covenant with the Beneficent Allah?
78.muhammad_sarwar: Has he the knowledge of the unseen or has the Beneficent God established such a binding agreement with Him?
78.mohsin_khan: Has he known the unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Beneficent (Allah)?
78.arberry: What, has he observed the Unseen, or taken a covenant with the All-merciful?

79.sahih_international: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
79.pickthall: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.
79.yusuf_ali: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment.
79.shakir: By no means! We write down what he says, and We will lengthen to him the length of the chastisement
79.muhammad_sarwar: Absolutely not, We will record his words and prolong his punishment.
79.mohsin_khan: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment (in the Hell);
79.arberry: No, indeed! We shall assuredly write down all that he says, and We shall prolong for him the chastisement;

80.sahih_international: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
80.pickthall: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).
80.yusuf_ali: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone.
80.shakir: And We will inherit of him what he says, and he shall come to Us alone.
80.muhammad_sarwar: All that he speaks of will belong to Us, and he will come into Our presence all alone.
80.mohsin_khan: And We shall inherit from him (at his death) all that he talks of (i.e. wealth and children which We have bestowed upon him in this world), and he shall come to Us alone.
80.arberry: and We shall inherit from him that he says, and he shall come to Us alone.

81.sahih_international: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
81.pickthall: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.
81.yusuf_ali: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory!
81.shakir: And they have taken gods besides Allah, that they should be to them a source of strength;
81.muhammad_sarwar: They have sought honor from other gods instead of God.
81.mohsin_khan: And they have taken (for worship) aliha (gods) besides Allah, that they might give them honour, power and glory (and also protect them from Allah's Punishment etc.).
81.arberry: And they have taken to them other gods apart from God, that they might be for them a might.

82.sahih_international: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
82.pickthall: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
82.yusuf_ali: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them.
82.shakir: By no means! They shall soon deny their worshipping them, and they shall be adversaries to them.
82.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, they can have no honor; their gods will renounce their worship of idols and will turn against them.
82.mohsin_khan: Nay, but they (the so-called gods) will deny their worship of them, and become opponents to them (on the Day of Resurrection).
82.arberry: No, indeed! They shall deny their service, and they shall be against them pitted.

83.sahih_international: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
83.pickthall: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?
83.yusuf_ali: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury?
83.shakir: Do you not see that We have sent the Shaitans against the unbelievers, inciting them by incitement?
83.muhammad_sarwar: Do you not realize that We have sent Satan to incite the unbelievers to sin.
83.mohsin_khan: See you not that We have sent the Shayatin (devils) against the disbelievers to push them to do evil.
83.arberry: Hast thou not seen how We sent the Satans against the unbelievers, to prick them?

84.sahih_international: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
84.pickthall: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
84.yusuf_ali: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days).
84.shakir: Therefore be not in haste against them, We only number out to them a number (of days).
84.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), exercise patience; We have given them respite only for an appointed time.
84.mohsin_khan: So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number (of the days of the life of this world and delay their term so that they may increase in evil and sins).
84.arberry: So hasten thou not against them; We are only numbering for them a number.

85.sahih_international: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
85.pickthall: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.
85.yusuf_ali: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours,
85.shakir: The day on which We will gather those who guard (against evil) to the Beneficent Allah to receive honors
85.muhammad_sarwar: On the Day of Judgment, when the pious people will be brought into the presence of the Beneficent God as the guests of honor
85.mohsin_khan: The Day We shall gather the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) unto the Most Beneficent (Allah), like a delegate (presented before a king for honour).
85.arberry: On the day that We shall muster the godfearing to the All-merciful with pomp

86.sahih_international: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
86.pickthall: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
86.yusuf_ali: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water,-
86.shakir: And We will drive the guilty to hell thirsty
86.muhammad_sarwar: and the criminals will be driven and thrown into hell,
86.mohsin_khan: And We shall drive the Mujrimun (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, etc.) to Hell, in a thirsty state (like a thirsty herd driven down to water),
86.arberry: and drive the evildoers into Gehenna herding,
