87.sahih_international: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
87.pickthall: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.
87.yusuf_ali: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious.
87.shakir: They shall not control intercession, save he who has made a covenant with the Beneficent Allah.
87.muhammad_sarwar: no one will be able to intercede for the others except those whom the Beneficent God has given authority.
87.mohsin_khan: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from the Most Beneficent (Allah).
87.arberry: having no power of intercession, save those who have taken with the All-merciful covenant.

88.sahih_international: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
88.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.
88.yusuf_ali: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
88.shakir: And they say: The Beneficent Allah has taken (to Himself) a son.
88.muhammad_sarwar: They have said that the Beneficent God has given birth to a son.
88.mohsin_khan: And they say: "The Most Beneficent (Allah) has begotten a son (or offspring or children) [as the Jews say: 'Uzair (Ezra) is the son of Allah, and the Christians say that He has begotten a son ['Iesa (Christ)], and the pagan Arabs say that He has begotten daughters (angels, etc.)]."
88.arberry: And they say, 'The All-merciful has taken unto Himself a son.

89.sahih_international: You have done an atrocious thing.
89.pickthall: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing
89.yusuf_ali: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous!
89.shakir: Certainly you have made an abominable assertion
89.muhammad_sarwar: This is certainly a monstrous lie!
89.mohsin_khan: Indeed you have brought forth (said) a terrible evil thing.
89.arberry: You have indeed advanced something hideous!

90.sahih_international: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
90.pickthall: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
90.yusuf_ali: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
90.shakir: The heavens may almost be rent thereat, and the earth cleave asunder, and the mountains fall down in pieces,
90.muhammad_sarwar: This would almost cause the heavens to rent apart, the earth to cleave asunder and the mountains to crumble down in fragments,
90.mohsin_khan: Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains fall in ruins,
90.arberry: The heavens are wellnigh rent of it and the earth split asunder, and the mountains wellnigh fall down crashing for

91.sahih_international: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
91.pickthall: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,
91.yusuf_ali: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious.
91.shakir: That they ascribe a son to the Beneficent Allah.
91.muhammad_sarwar: to ascribe a son to the Beneficent God.
91.mohsin_khan: That they ascribe a son (or offspring or children) to the Most Beneficent (Allah).
91.arberry: that they have attributed to the All-merciful a son;

92.sahih_international: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
92.pickthall: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
92.yusuf_ali: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
92.shakir: And it is not worthy of the Beneficent Allah that He should take (to Himself) a son.
92.muhammad_sarwar: The Beneficent God is too Exalted to have a son.
92.mohsin_khan: But it is not suitable for (the Majesty of) the Most Beneficent (Allah) that He should beget a son (or offspring or children).
92.arberry: and it behoves not the All-merciful to take a son.

93.sahih_international: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
93.pickthall: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
93.yusuf_ali: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
93.shakir: There is no one in the heavens and the earth but will come to the Beneficent Allah as a servant.
93.muhammad_sarwar: All that is in the heavens and the earth will return to the Beneficent God as His submissive servants.
93.mohsin_khan: There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Beneficent (Allah) as a slave.
93.arberry: None is there in the heavens and earth but he comes to the All-merciful as a servant;

94.sahih_international: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
94.pickthall: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
94.yusuf_ali: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly.
94.shakir: Certainly He has a comprehensive knowledge of them and He has numbered them a (comprehensive) numbering.
94.muhammad_sarwar: He has counted and enumerated them one by one.
94.mohsin_khan: Verily, He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting.
94.arberry: He has indeed counted them, and He has numbered them exactly.

95.sahih_international: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
95.pickthall: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
95.yusuf_ali: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment.
95.shakir: And every one of them will come to Him on the day of resurrection alone.
95.muhammad_sarwar: Everyone on the Day of Judgment will individually come into the presence of God.
95.mohsin_khan: And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection (without any helper, or protector or defender).
95.arberry: Every one of them shall come to Him upon the Day of Resurrection, all alone.

96.sahih_international: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
96.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
96.yusuf_ali: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
96.shakir: Surely (as for) those who believe and do good deeds for them will Allah bring about love.
96.muhammad_sarwar: To the righteously striving believers God will grant love.
96.mohsin_khan: Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allah and in His Messenger (Muhammad SAW)] and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Beneficent (Allah) will bestow love for them (in the hearts of the believers).
96.arberry: Surely those who believe and do deeds of righteousness -- unto them the All-merciful shall assign love.

97.sahih_international: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
97.pickthall: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
97.yusuf_ali: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention.
97.shakir: So We have only made it easy in your tongue that you may give good news thereby to those who guard (against evil) and warn thereby a vehemently contentious people.
97.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), We have given you the Book (the Quran) in your own language so that you could easily give the glad news to the pious ones and warn the quarrelsome ones.
97.mohsin_khan: So We have made this (the Quran) easy in your own tongue (O Muhammad SAW), only that you may give glad tidings to the Muttaqun (pious and righteous persons - See V. 2:2), and warn with it the Ludda (most quarrelsome) people.
97.arberry: Now We have made it easy by thy tongue that thou mayest bear good tidings thereby to the godfearing, and warn a people stubborn.

98.sahih_international: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
98.pickthall: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?
98.yusuf_ali: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them?
98.shakir: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them! Do you see any one of them or hear a sound of them?
98.muhammad_sarwar: How many generations living before them did We destroy? Do you find anyone of them around or do you even hear any word from them?
98.mohsin_khan: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you (O Muhammad SAW) find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them?
98.arberry: And how many a generation We destroyed before them! Dost thou perceive so much as one of them, or hear of them a whisper?
